lines.en: I swim along the sandy ridge of the riverbed.
Triassic water is murky.
My tailbeat stirs the mud up.

lines.zh: 半格长的身子，钻得进浅沟。
lines.en: Half a block long, I fit into the shallow groove.
The marsh is warmer. I head there.
I avoid the quickest current.
Slow fins, holding steady.

lines.zh: 岸边的蕨影落在水面上。
lines.en: Fern shadows fall on the surface from the bank.
I glide over the mud, foraging.
I move from the shallows into deeper water.
I brush a weed and shrink back.
I turn in the river bend.
One flick of the tail changes my course.
The current on the flats is slow.
I swim past a sunken log.

lines.zh: 水底下的东西，我都看得见。
lines.en: I can see everything on the bottom.
I lie on the mud, only my fins moving.
The water's warm. Just right for me.
The snails on the bed — too hard for me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张着，水自己流过去。
lines.en: My mouth stays open; water flows through.
The marsh mud is soft enough to sink into.
A fish this small has large enemies.
I hide beneath the sunken log.
The surface is bright. Below is dark.
I wait for small insects to fall in.
My fins work, gently, gently.
A leaf drifted past.

lines.zh: 我在河湾的静水里停着。
lines.en: I rest in the still water of the bend.
There's a groove in the mud. Mine.
In this water I'm on the small side.
You're on the bank. Your shadow falls here.
I'm only half a block or so.
Don't come in. Cloud the water and I'm gone.
You crouch and I sink.
You look strange through the water.
I move outside your shadow.
To eat me you'd have to wade in.
I stop beside the sunken log.

lines.zh: 水面的影子一晃，我抬头。
lines.en: The shadow on the water shifts; I look up.
I flick back into the weeds.
A fin is torn.
I sink to the mud and stay still.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，一打就见血。
lines.en: At this size, one blow draws blood.
I squeeze under the sunken log.
Blood spreads; I burrow into the mud.
I can't swim. Only drift.
I flipped and had to right myself.
Scales sink; I twist away.
When it quickens I get pushed along.
I'm still afloat. Not sinking.
Something dropped into the water.
I swim close and circle it.
That smells edible.
I gulp it and nearly choke.
That scrap of meat is one mouthful.

lines.zh: 水里散开的味道，很快就没了。
lines.en: The taste fades fast in water.

lines.zh: 你撒的这点，我都捡不完。
lines.en: Too little to bother gathering.
Drop some more. I'm still here.
I circle twice at the surface.
Lower it slowly. Don't slap the water.
One knock and I rolled over.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅滩，我撞上你的脚。
lines.en: You stepped into the shallows and I hit your foot.
I'm so light you'd not feel it.
I've stirred up the mud.
I slide away past your calf.
When the water's confused I lose my heading.
We touch and both stop.
I sink toward deeper water.
The mud you churned is hiding me.
I back off half a foot and steady my fins.
Swimming side by side is enough.
The weeds can hide us both.
Follow me to the far marsh.
Triassic water, warm just right.
Our tails beat in the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 这条河里，我们的日子不长。
lines.en: Our days in this river aren't long.
The eggs belong at the weed roots.
Don't swim far. Stay in this bend.
Let's go down the current together.
The water will remember us.
I take it in my mouth and test it.
Too heavy to hold.

lines.zh: 钦利组的河底，我翻石头找食。
lines.en: On the Chinle riverbed I flip stones for food.
There's something under the log.
I sweep it into the mud.
A shell. Can't bite it.
I swallow and it sticks.
The riverbed is mine.
Carrying it slows me.
This much will last a day.
The mud bulges; I swim toward it.
I hold and only roll my eye.
Blood in the water.
I drift downstream a little.
That thing's too big.
I hide under the log's shadow.
It's above; I'm on the mud.
I'll see which way it goes.
Fins flat. Don't move.
See if it goes.
The water churns, and I go down.
It's gone. I come out.
I follow that shadow.
When it moves, the water sways.
I watch from behind the log.
The muddy bottom hides things. Good.
It hasn't looked down.

lines.zh: 水流推着我，靠近你的倒影。
lines.en: The current pushes me toward your reflection.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的水里，我游得低。
lines.en: In Triassic water, I swim low.
I stay still. Let it move first.
My fins tremble. I still them.
Ease off a little. No rush.

lines.zh: 水草在摇，是我们的动静。
lines.en: The weeds sway. That's us.
It turned and went upstream.
I withdraw into the deep.
I dart in and bite.
Small teeth. Only soft things.
Bite and burrow into the mud.
I swing my tail at its shin.
That strength lasts one blow.
It slaps a hand into the water.
The water's all silt. I can't see.
Dodged. My heart hasn't settled.
Holding on is too dangerous.
I let go and dive.
That's all I can do, at this size.
After that bite, still alive.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的浅水里，我冒出头。
lines.en: In Triassic shallows, I poke my head out.
The river's murky. Good cover.
I'm shorter than a brick.

lines.zh: 蕨类的影子盖在水面上。
lines.en: Fern shadows lie on the water.
I circle the stone once.
The water here is warmer than elsewhere.
I head for the shallows.
Muddy bottom. I like it.
Something's walking up there.
I sink and wait.
This river isn't big.
I flick my tail and row upstream.
There's food toward the marsh.
First a mouthful from the mud.
The water turned hot. I burrow into the mud.
I fell from the surface back to the bed.

lines.zh: 水太浅，我鳃里进不了水。
lines.en: Too shallow — no water reaches my gills.
The blast filled the river with mud.

lines.zh: 那东西从我体侧穿过去。
lines.en: It passed straight through my flank.

lines.zh: 那光在水里散开，刺得我缩起来。
lines.en: That light spread in the water and made me flinch.

lines.zh: 河里没虫了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No insects in the river. I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我全身僵住。
lines.en: Lightning struck the river and I went rigid.
No water here.
